$doc: DING / SHOCK set: the small bell dings and the stinger-style shock hits that live in this folder (legacy folder name, kept because comps reference these paths). Pick by `trigger` + `mood_class`. Mirrors ../Impacts/library.json. Character fields were measured (duration, attack, peak, tail) and named from the file; `mood_source` says so. Master index: ../library.json (rebuilt by video-creation/skills/sfx-library/scripts/sfx_catalog.py).
$schema_note: `attack_sec` = seconds from file start to the loudest sample: place the file so the attack lands ON the frame of the event. `tail_sec` = seconds the sound keeps ringing after its peak (30 dB down). `mood_class` is the HARD-GATE mood (longform-edited.md section 7): dark / tense / epic / hype / neutral.

ding.title: Ding
ding.character: bright bell ding, instant attack, ~1 s ring then a quiet 3 s tail
ding.trigger: a WIN / correct-answer / winner-reveal moment; a coin or token panel appearing
ding.best_for: the winner-coin reveal, a checkmark landing, a 'that one' pick
ding.license: unknown origin; short SFX, no Content-ID code; confirm before a new commercial use

ding.title: Dramatic Shocked (sfxshocked)
ding.character: dramatic shock stinger, 1.3 s swell into the hit, long 3 s ring, low-mid heavy
ding.trigger: a SHOCKING fact or a dramatic reveal that should land with dread
ding.best_for: the 'holy crap' number, a bad-news reveal; never in a bright/hype chapter
ding.license: unknown origin; short SFX, no Content-ID code; confirm before a new commercial use

ding.title: Rising Dramatic Riser
ding.character: 6 s dramatic riser peaking at the very end, then stops; pair with an impact on the cut
ding.trigger: the build INTO a reveal or a chapter card; cut the video on its peak
ding.best_for: a 6 s build under the last line before a reveal; see ../risers/library.json for the catalogued risers first
ding.license: unknown origin; short SFX, no Content-ID code; confirm before a new commercial use

ding.title: Sudden Shock
ding.character: short shock stinger, hit at 0.3 s, 0.8 s ring
ding.trigger: a SUDDEN twist or a 'wait' beat; a stat that flips the argument
ding.best_for: a quick jolt under a one-line twist; the -tight twin for a hard cut
ding.license: unknown origin; short SFX, no Content-ID code; confirm before a new commercial use

ding.title: Sudden Shock (tight)
ding.character: the same shock hit trimmed to 0.4 s, no ring
ding.trigger: the same twist beat when the next cut comes fast and a ring would smear over it
ding.best_for: a jolt on a hard cut
ding.license: unknown origin; short SFX, no Content-ID code; confirm before a new commercial use
